summary: OpenAI restructured ChatGPT and Codex usage limits so a weekly limit governs the primary cap, reported suspending the shared five-hour window on Plus, Pro, and Business plans, while adding purchasable ChatGPT credits to continue past included usage and banked rate-limit resets earned through referrals.
title: OpenAI Made Weekly Limits Primary For ChatGPT Codex Usage And Added Purchasable Credits
